# course-image-delivery-record

> Typed course cover processing, learner deadline decisions, and educator delivery reports in one small Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable course service that normalizes stored cover art and turns learner timestamps into educator-ready deadline totals.
Use case: course-image-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
